description.en: Greece, officially the Hellenic Republic, is a country located mostly on the Balkan peninsula of Southeastern Europe, with thousands of islands extending geographically to Asia Minor. It has a population of around 10 million.
description.zh-CN: 希臘共和國，簡稱希臘，是位於歐洲南部的發達跨大陸國家。2024年其人口為1,039萬。
